dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: From the looks of it, I'm guessing you found it.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Yeah! That deer led us into a forest, and there were so many puffins in there!

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: And then, one of them flew onto my head, before nestling into my arms!

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: I don't know how, but I recognized it straight away — it was the puffin I rescued.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Kari was grinning like an idiot chasing that little thing around and around. Hmph, no sense of decorum whatsoever...

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: What about you? When those puffins landed on you, you totally froze up!

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Huh!? If I'd moved, they'd have all fallen off! I was thinking about their safety.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Uhm... Birds... Birds can fall off things too, you know!
